styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white cards floating over misty blue-grey panels; soft grey velvet and pale stone surfaces for macro and scene shots

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: elegant feminine jewelry ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue-grey #A9BFD4, clean white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, pearl silver-white #E9ECEF, and one soft dusty rose accent #EFC4C6; neutral-cool tone with soft rose warmth only in gift cards; modern geometric sans-serif typography with wide letter-spaced headlines; layered layout system of clean white cards floating over muted blue-grey panels, soft grey velvet and pale stone surfaces; bright diffused studio lighting with controlled highlights, gentle contact shadows and restrained sparkle; consistent numbered square markers, thin rounded-rectangle labels and thin-line icons; jewelry rendered at true scale with macro clarity, centered stable placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
